not_verified.item: Total number of competing 'client handoff/offboarding' listings
not_verified.reason: Marketplace search is client-rendered and not enumerable by a read-only GET; only individually surfaced listings were confirmed. UNKNOWN (confirmed lower bound: 7 paid Gumroad listings + Payhip + 3 own-site, prices $3.49-$54.89).

competition_level: HIGH: 8+ real paid comparables confirmed in the exact client-handoff/offboarding niche ($3.49 to $54.89; mode ~$15), plus a free self-assessment funnel. This is markedly more crowded than B12-004 (4 comparables), and several entrants bundle more files than our two-file pack. Proven demand, but weak room to differentiate on content alone.

price_recommendation.basis: The closely-shaped comparables (ClearDesk Payhip $12, Copper Vault $12, ClientReady $15, CleanExit $15) cluster at $12-$15; a $3.49 floor competitor exists. Consistent with the B12-001/B12-004 precedent of pricing just below the most comparable, $11.99 sits at/below the $12-15 cluster while our two-file pack is simpler than the multi-file bundles.
price_recommendation.note: A premium price ($29, matching the Website Handoff Kit) is not defensible for a two-file pack against 8+ rivals; the gate's numeric ceiling is loose here (highest comparable $54.89) so price is NOT the binding constraint - content depth and differentiation are.
